subject.title: Tool outputs sometimes render as image attachments and become unreadable to the agent

question: What proof is sufficient to close this canonical tool-result text-loss issue after the prompt-projection and provider-media candidate fixes are resolved?
rationale: Source and discussion show partial fixes, but no current-main installed long-session proof covers the reported model-visible text-loss path and a candidate PR remains open.

options.title: Require installed long-session proof
options.body: Close only after a real installed session demonstrates ordinary text tool results remain readable by the model under context pressure after the focused fixes land.

options.title: Accept helper-level proof after PR 99524
options.body: Allow closure once the focused regression tests and CI for the remaining non-trailing fresh-result case pass, with live proof tracked separately.

options.title: Split provider placeholder tracking
options.body: Close only the aggregate-recovery portion and keep provider/media placeholder behavior in a narrower follow-up issue.

recommendation.title: Require installed long-session proof
recommendation.body: Close only after a real installed session demonstrates ordinary text tool results remain readable by the model under context pressure after the focused fixes land.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the same prompt-history projection path makes this the best available owner for deciding the closure proof bar.
